properties.name: conductor.file-storage.conductor.directory
properties.description: Directory used by the Conductor filesystem backend. It must be shared by all server nodes in a multi-node deployment.

properties.name: conductor.file-storage.conductor.base-url
properties.description: Public Conductor base URL for file transfer URLs. When unset, the origin is derived from the current request.

properties.name: conductor.file-storage.conductor.max-size
properties.description: Maximum number of bytes accepted by a single filesystem upload.

properties.name: conductor.file-storage.conductor.signing.enabled
properties.description: Whether generated Conductor content URLs include HMAC signature parameters.

properties.name: conductor.file-storage.conductor.signing.keys
properties.description: Ordered HMAC signing keys. The first key signs new URLs and all keys verify existing URLs.
